routine.title: Football Conditioning — No Game
routine.notes: Use only when a planned football session is NOT happening. Do not stack this on top of a hard game/double session. Built as a football-specific interval option rather than punishment volume.

exercises.notes: Sprint-run-walk block. Use the pace pattern you already know from your football conditioning work. Keep the sprint portions fast but repeatable; the final rep should still look like the first. Two blocks only when recovered.
